description: Flight status and airport delays, live: by airport code, FAA ground stops and delay programs with average and max delay (US), live departure and arrival boards with gates and status (Norway), current METAR and TAF weather (any ICAO airport) and aircraft overhead; by callsign, the aircraft's live position, altitude and speed. Input: airport (IATA or ICAO) or callsign; optional flight, direction, hours_ahead. $0.25 per call.
name: hubvibe_travel_flight_status
